decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf fits the firm's core heritage assortment, costs little to keep producing alongside established breads, and is a staple with steady demand.
The historic mill tour builds on the firm's existing event and hospitality facilities, reinforces its tradition-based brand, and has low marginal cost, so it is likely to continue.
The sweet pastry is close to the existing confectionery range and easy to keep; bakeries do rotate pastries, but there is no sign of weak results that would justify dropping it now.
